function.description: Attach files from the workspace to a file field (an image, a document). Give the index of the file field, its upload button or its drop area; no index is needed when the page has one file field.
function.name: browser_upload_file

parameters.description: Model for attaching workspace files to a file field.

elementIndex.description: The file field, or its upload button or drop area. Not needed when the page has one file field

paths.description: Workspace paths of the files to attach
